title: A worker branch is pushed to the integration remote at stage-back when its landing is placed off the workstation, and land deletes it after
goal: bl_dispatch.push_work_branch(root, item) pushes work/<item> to the integration remote with --force-with-lease against the remote tip it last saw (none for a first push), and stage-back calls it when kbjob.py place land ITEM gives an executor other than workstation; a lease that no longer holds exits 1 naming the branch; bl_land.delete_remote_work_branch(root, item) removes it once the item landed; nothing ever pushes work/* to the publish remote, and the pre-push guard refuses such a push

run:
import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,os.path.abspath("_tools")); import bl_dispatch,bl_land
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); o=os.path.join(d,"o.git"); w=os.path.join(d,"w"); g=lambda *x,cwd=w: subprocess.run(["git",*x],cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True)
subprocess.run(["git","init","-q","--bare",o],check=True); subprocess.run(["git","clone","-q",o,w],check=True)
g("config","user.email","jan.kowalski@corp.example.com"); g("config","user.name","jan.kowalski"); g("commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m","base"); g("push","-q","origin","HEAD:main")
g("checkout","-q","-b","work/ST-aaaaaaaa"); g("commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m","work")
r1=bl_dispatch.push_work_branch(w,"ST-aaaaaaaa"); on=g("ls-remote","origin","refs/heads/work/ST-aaaaaaaa").stdout
w2=os.path.join(d,"w2"); subprocess.run(["git","clone","-q",o,w2],check=True); g("config","user.email","a@corp.example.com",cwd=w2); g("config","user.name","a",cwd=w2)
g("checkout","-q","work/ST-aaaaaaaa",cwd=w2); g("commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m","other",cwd=w2); g("push","-q","origin","work/ST-aaaaaaaa",cwd=w2)
g("commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m","more"); r2=bl_dispatch.push_work_branch(w,"ST-aaaaaaaa")
bl_land.delete_remote_work_branch(w,"ST-aaaaaaaa"); off=g("ls-remote","origin","refs/heads/work/ST-aaaaaaaa").stdout
assert r1==0 and on.strip() and r2==1 and not off.strip(), (r1,r2,on,off)
